set_aside: v. 2, Yom Kippur morning reader's repetition (Ashkenaz Kedushah; Sefard reader's repetition), piyyut rhyming on בָּשָׂר: "בָּשָׂר. צוּר" spans a line break of the piyyut; idiom, not this psalm.

v. 9, Yom Kippur services (Maariv, Shacharit, Musaf, Mincha; Ashkenaz and Sefard), "אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ וְאַל תַּכְלִימֵנוּ": stock formula whose order follows 1 Kgs 8:57, not this psalm.
v. 9, Sefard prayer upon arising (Sefard siddur; Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur machzorim): the same "אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ" formula; not this psalm.

v. 9, *El erekh apayim* before the weekday Torah reading (Sefard; Edot HaMizrach): "אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנּוּ" is a stock plea shared with Ps 69:18, 102:3 and 143:7; it cannot be tied to this psalm.
v. 9, Keter Malkhut: "אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי", the same stock plea shared with several psalms; not this psalm.
v. 11, Aramaic prayer רִבּוֹן עָלְמָא (Edot HaMizrach weekday Shacharit; Edot HaMizrach Yom Kippur Shacharit, Akeidah): "בְּאֹרַח מֵישַׁר" is an Aramaic idiom, not this psalm.
v. 11, Ma'avar Yabbok, *Sefat Emet*: "אזיל בארח מישור" inside a Zohar quotation, set against "ארח תקלה"; Aramaic idiom, not this psalm.
